summary: Comprehensive testing of dietary tags feature (No Onion/Garlic and Fasting Friendly). All features working correctly - backend API returns dietary fields, admin panel has checkboxes for editing, and badges display on Menu and Pickup pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Dietary tags implementation is complete and well-structured
Backend MenuItem model includes no_onion_garlic and fasting_friendly boolean fields with defaults
Admin form includes checkboxes with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Menu.js displays badges in cards and modal with correct colors (orange for No Onion/Garlic, purple for Fasting Friendly)
Pickup.js MenuItemCard component displays dietary badges correctly
seed_data_creation: Two items already tagged: Sabudana Khichadi (id: e746b985-7519-4133-ba4b-a8aa0000f497) and Sabudana Thalipith - both have no_onion_garlic=true and fasting_friendly=true
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dietary tags feature is fully functional. Backend has 173 menu items, 2 items have dietary tags set. Admin panel checkboxes work for create/edit. Badges display correctly on Menu page (cards + modal) and Pickup page.
